digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate / impact model calibration (plan-v3 → plan-v4)
propositions: The divergent_implementation axis is uncalibrated (7.72% fire rate, born in d487060b with one line of prose) and mis-grades 90% of its target class (omitted scope sites) as none, causing 770 findings to score impact 0.0 and block incorrectly at advisory despite validity 0.8889 and blocking_enabled=true.

Replacing the ordinal ladder (none|low|medium|high) with a closed Literal set (none, contradicts_reality, omits_required_site, incomplete_enumeration) floors contradicts_reality and omits_required_site at 0.85 (catching the omitted-site family) while incomplete_enumeration returns a contribution pinned below 0.60 (pressure-relief valve).

The implementation must exclude divergent_implementation from _SEV01 and resolve it through DIVERGENCE_GRADE01 instead, with _PLAN_GRADED_AXES driving both contribution and override loops, preventing silent 0.0 scoring that would stop the axis from firing entirely.

A prod_impact floor (Fix 2) collides structurally with novelty_priority_floor=0.4 convergence by lifting an unbounded severity band orthogonal to remediation; Fix 1's semantic grading is subsumed and preferred.

ADR 0054 records explicit rejection of purpose-built LLM eval suites and bulk re-review for calibration, permitting only corpus replay and dogfood+observe (zero marginal LLM cost), narrowing ADR 0036's A/B clause while preserving version-segmentation.

Pre-landing corpus replay bounds the worst-case decision swing at 81 new blocks across 1,396 findings with non-none grades (far below the 113-finding over-fire an ungraded widening would produce), with dogfooding (per ADR 0054) determining the realized outcome.
